Due to regulatory restrictions, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta is unavailable.  
Furthermore, the flight plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two mandatory corridors: the link between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the link between Station Gamma and Station Delta.  

The objective is to determine the most efficient cyclic inspection route that visits every monitoring station precisely once and concludes at the initial station, minimizing the total flight distance.
